slug: 2025-05-29 Biometric payment card system pushing financial inclusion in Botswana

BWA.note: Document does not mention public procurement.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.

facts.fact: More than 75,000 food-voucher beneficiaries completed digital purchases at local stores with SmartSwitch Botswana's biometrics-enabled smart card, described as government social-benefit payments.

BWA.note: Closed-loop government benefit card, not mobile money or wallets.
No tax or fee payment stated.
